docker.enabled.label: Docker
docker.enabled.description: Shows what Docker keeps on your Mac and the command that frees each part. Fresher never removes anything of Docker's.
docker.title: {runtime}
docker.runtime.docker-desktop.gives-back: Docker Desktop gives the space freed inside it back to your Mac by itself, usually within minutes.
docker.runtime.orbstack.gives-back: OrbStack gives the space freed inside it back to your Mac by itself.
docker.summary.answered: {runtime} uses {inside} inside its disk file; {unused} of it is unused.
docker.summary.stopped: {runtime} is not running, so Fresher cannot see what is inside. Start it and scan again; Fresher never starts it.
docker.summary.restored: These numbers are from your last scan. Scan again to see what is inside {runtime}.
docker.summary.unknown: Fresher could not tell whether {runtime} is running, so it did not ask it.
docker.summary.no-answer: {runtime} did not answer. Scan again once it has fully started.
docker.summary.unreadable: {runtime} answered in a way Fresher cannot read, so it shows no numbers rather than guess.
docker.summary.left: {runtime} is not installed any more, but its disk file is still on your Mac.
docker.part.build-cache.label: Build cache
docker.part.build-cache.detail: Saved build steps no build uses now.
docker.part.build-cache.effect: The next builds take longer: Docker repeats those steps.
docker.part.images.label: Unused images
docker.part.images.effect: An image is downloaded or built again when you need it.
docker.part.containers.label: Stopped containers
docker.part.containers.effect: Anything written inside them is lost for good.
docker.part.volumes.label: Unused volumes
docker.part.volumes.effect: A volume may hold the only copy of a database. The command removes only volumes without a name; Docker counts both here.
docker.note.disk-unseen: Fresher could not see the disk file. Allow access to other apps' data in Settings and scan again.
docker.note.never-runs: Fresher never runs these commands. Copy one into Terminal; Docker asks you to confirm before it removes anything.
